title: Narra 4.1.19
message: Narra Server playback, account recovery, and Premium status refresh are improved in this release.
changelog: Narra Server is available for securely authorized Premium playback and keeps stream resolution on the device.
Subtitle tracks and SUB/DUB audio selection are preserved when the upstream source provides them.
Account verification now clears stale account benefits on an account switch and retries after connectivity returns.
Premium days remaining are calculated from the verified expiry time so the app matches the gateway dashboard.
The latest MainActivity startup and Android TV routing changes are included.
Existing public anime providers and automatic playback recovery remain available as fallbacks.
Player recovery keeps the selected episode and audio mode while moving between providers.
Comic, manga, audiobook, saved-list, and TV improvements from the previous release remain included.
